what: Tickets carried only title+acceptance, no scope sections or contracts, so workers invented a schema (S2) and wrote tests that matched their own code; the wrong schema passed all its tests until I ran submit_request
rule: Tests must be derived from scope acceptance criteria and the data-model contract, not from the worker's own code; every ticket gets its scope sections plus contracts as context.
fix: auto-attach scope.md requirement text, the data model section and generated contracts to each ticket's context; generate test tickets from acceptance bullets by a different worker than the builder
